scope: 17 locally readable Wildbound user chats; 975 user-message records screened, positive candidates read in surrounding context. Not a claim to all cloud or other-computer chats.
method: Read-only local Codex session records and native chat metadata. Only original user messages count as approval. Assistant descriptions and interpretations are not user approval.

bestInputRecipe.target: Exact asset and active rig/item ID; use existing source if identifiable.
bestInputRecipe.primaryReference: One main visual reference; say which proportions, silhouette, palette or material to borrow.
bestInputRecipe.secondaryReferences: Optional donor for motion, separately labeled; a 3D donor is not automatically the pixel-art style.
bestInputRecipe.markup: Mark where pivots, limbs, shaft, hat or near/far layers belong in relevant views.
bestInputRecipe.constraints: Gameplay pixel scale, palette, all eight views, asymmetric details, saved custom layers to preserve.
bestInputRecipe.success: One assembled sample at native gameplay and inventory sizes, compared beside actual reference; short loop if motion matters.

workflow: Inspect active checkout, selected rig and saved overrides.
Write a short visual contract with specific large shape and value decisions.
Resolve each view silhouette, broad shadow/highlight masses, one or two identifying details, then overall outline.
Render real assembled sample before family rollout. Review silhouette, identity, color clusters, turning logic, animation fit separately.
After explicit style rejection, obtain approval for the revised sample before expanding its family. Routine authorized fixes continue.
Keep technical test results separate from aesthetic approval. Save source, selected refs, review image and exact feedback status.
